blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution urged Filipinos still undecided whether Vice President Sara Duterte should be convicted or acquitted in her impeachment trial to review the evidence that it has already presented before the Senate court. Rep. Joel Chua, a member of the House prosecution panel, made the call in a statement issued on Tuesday, saying in Filipino, “We have seen, when the prosecution made its presentation, and when we have finished, that we have laid down the evidence properly.” He cited the third-quarter Tugon ng Masa survey conducted by OCTA Research from Sept. 28 to Oct. 4, which found […]...
